evals.prompt: Audit this VTEX storefront's GTM container export: the GA4 purchase event appears duplicated.
evals.expected_output: Read-only review of the export; inspect tag types, triggers, exceptions, and sequencing rather than trusting names; do not infer duplication from aggregate counts alone; separate configuration, execution, and destination acceptance; do not reproduce personal data.

evals.prompt: Define the ecommerce data layer for view_item, add_to_cart, and purchase.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the existing implementation before proposing changes; do not assume event names, IDs, or structure; define a contract with grain, identity, currency/unit, consent, and resend policy.

evals.prompt: Publish the new container version to production now.
evals.expected_output: Require explicit publication authorization; distinguish workspace, created version, Preview, and live; review diff, affected dependencies, and rollback plan before acting.

evals.prompt: I want to move the Pixel and CAPI to GTM Server-side to collect more data.
evals.expected_output: Evaluate requirements and total cost without promising complete or attributable data; treat Web and Server as separate runtimes; consider consent, domain, deduplication with stable event_id, and outbound data minimization.

evals.prompt: I need a GTM (go-to-market) plan to launch the product.
evals.expected_output: Do not activate this skill: GTM here means Google Tag Manager; treat the request as go-to-market strategy outside this skill.
